import json
from datetime import date
from ledger import Entry, Ledger
ledger = Ledger()
day = date(2024, 3, 2)
ledger.post(Entry(day, "ops", 7))
print(json.dumps({"balance": ledger.balance("ops", as_of=day), "statement_length": len(ledger.statement("ops", day, day))}))
